AGRICULTURE — MOCK EXAM #4
====

GRADE: Grade 5
SUBJECT: AGRICULTURE
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours
TOTAL MARKS: 80
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which change is a physical change? (1 mark)
   A. Iron rusting
   B. Paper burning to ash
   C. Milk souring
   D. Ice melting to water

2. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Food Nutrients? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Food Nutrients.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Food Nutrients.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Food Nutrients.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Food Nutrients.

3. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Conserving Wild Animals? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Conserving Wild Animals.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Conserving Wild Animals.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Conserving Wild Animals.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Conserving Wild Animals.

4. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Good Grooming Practices 7 3.2 Home Hygiene 9 3.3 Laundering Cotton Item 10 4.0 P? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Good Grooming Practices 7 3.2 Home Hygiene 9 3.3 Laundering Cotton Item 10 4.0 P.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Good Grooming Practices 7 3.2 Home Hygiene 9 3.3 Laundering Cotton Item 10 4.0 P.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Good Grooming Practices 7 3.2 Home Hygiene 9 3.3 Laundering Cotton Item 10 4.0 P.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Good Grooming Practices 7 3.2 Home Hygiene 9 3.3 Laundering Cotton Item 10 4.0 P.

5. Why is water unsuitable for a petrol fire? (1 mark)
   A. Water removes heat too quickly
   B. Water can spread burning petrol instead of putting it out safely
   C. Water always increases oxygen
   D. Petrol fires have no fuel

6. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Soil Conservation? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Soil Conservation.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Soil Conservation.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Soil Conservation.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Soil Conservation.

7. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Food Nutrients 10 2.5 Cooking Food 9 3.0 Hygiene Practices 3.1 Good Grooming Pra? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Food Nutrients 10 2.5 Cooking Food 9 3.0 Hygiene Practices 3.1 Good Grooming Pra.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Food Nutrients 10 2.5 Cooking Food 9 3.0 Hygiene Practices 3.1 Good Grooming Pra.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Food Nutrients 10 2.5 Cooking Food 9 3.0 Hygiene Practices 3.1 Good Grooming Pra.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Food Nutrients 10 2.5 Cooking Food 9 3.0 Hygiene Practices 3.1 Good Grooming Pra.

8. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Preservation of Cereals and Pulses 10 2.4 Food Nutrients 10 2.5 Cooking Food 9 3? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Preservation of Cereals and Pulses 10 2.4 Food Nutrients 10 2.5 Cooking Food 9 3.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Preservation of Cereals and Pulses 10 2.4 Food Nutrients 10 2.5 Cooking Food 9 3.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Preservation of Cereals and Pulses 10 2.4 Food Nutrients 10 2.5 Cooking Food 9 3.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Preservation of Cereals and Pulses 10 2.4 Food Nutrients 10 2.5 Cooking Food 9 3.

9. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Preservation of Cereals and Pulses? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Preservation of Cereals and Pulses.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Preservation of Cereals and Pulses.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Preservation of Cereals and Pulses.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Preservation of Cereals and Pulses.

10. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Cooking Food Frying Frying? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Cooking Food Frying Frying.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Cooking Food Frying Frying.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Cooking Food Frying Frying.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Cooking Food Frying Frying.

11. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Uses of Domestic Animals? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Uses of Domestic Animals.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Uses of Domestic Animals.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Uses of Domestic Animals.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Uses of Domestic Animals.

12. Soil erosion is reduced by: (1 mark)
   A. Burning crop residue every week
   B. Planting cover crops and terracing slopes
   C. Overgrazing continuously
   D. Removing all vegetation

13. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Uses of Domestic Animals 8 2.3 Preservation of Cereals and Pulses 10 2.4 Food Nu? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Uses of Domestic Animals 8 2.3 Preservation of Cereals and Pulses 10 2.4 Food Nu.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Uses of Domestic Animals 8 2.3 Preservation of Cereals and Pulses 10 2.4 Food Nu.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Uses of Domestic Animals 8 2.3 Preservation of Cereals and Pulses 10 2.4 Food Nu.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Uses of Domestic Animals 8 2.3 Preservation of Cereals and Pulses 10 2.4 Food Nu.

14. In a food chain, green plants are usually: (1 mark)
   A. Tertiary consumers
   B. Decomposers only
   C. Primary consumers only
   D. Producers

15. Boiling point of pure water at standard pressure is about: (1 mark)
   A. 37 °C
   B. 100 °C
   C. 0 °C
   D. 50 °C

16. Photosynthesis mainly produces: (1 mark)
   A. Glucose and oxygen
   B. Only water vapour
   C. Nitrogen gas only
   D. Only carbon dioxide

17. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Growing Vegetables? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Growing Vegetables.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Growing Vegetables.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Growing Vegetables.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Growing Vegetables.

18. Diffusion is best described as: (1 mark)
   A. Movement of water only across a membrane
   B. Heating until a solid melts
   C. A chemical reaction forming ash
   D. Net movement of particles from high to low concentration

19. An element is: (1 mark)
   A. A pure substance that cannot be broken down into a simpler substance by chemical means
   B. Any substance that conducts electricity
   C. Any white crystal used in cooking
   D. A mixture of two liquids

20. The SI unit of force is the: (1 mark)
   A. pascal (Pa)
   B. watt (W)
   C. joule (J)
   D. newton (N)

21. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Water Conservation? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Water Conservation.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Water Conservation.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Water Conservation.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Water Conservation.

22. A compound differs from a mixture because: (1 mark)
   A. A mixture always has a fixed melting point
   B. Elements in a compound are chemically combined in a fixed ratio
   C. Mixtures cannot exist in Kenya
   D. A compound can be separated by filtering only

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----

24. In three clear sentences, explain Growing Vegetables and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

30. In three clear sentences, explain Food Nutrients and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
